common:
Create a premium HAVENLINE game-resource 360-degree concept turnaround sheet, matching the supplied Havenline art boards precisely in visual language: polished stylized 3D, chunky rounded forms, broad sculpted details, warm caramel wood, restrained cool-metal highlights, readable game silhouettes, handcrafted inviting winter-survival aesthetic. The reference images are STYLE references, not edit targets. Do not copy their buildings, layout, UI or tiny text.
Landscape high-resolution sheet, ideally 3072x2048. Uniform dark navy studio background. Elegant clear small heading at top and eight equally sized view panels arranged exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows. Same SINGLE asset rotated in place about the vertical axis, same physical geometry and color/material pattern in EVERY panel. Camera elevation 15 degrees above horizontal, orthographic-like product rendering. Consistent subject scale, fixed soft neutral studio light, generous margins, fully visible objects. Exact clockwise yaw order: top row FRONT 0°, FRONT RIGHT 45°, RIGHT 90°, REAR RIGHT 135°; bottom row REAR 180°, REAR LEFT 225°, LEFT 270°, FRONT LEFT 315°. Front and rear must be genuinely opposite surfaces; right and left are true narrow end/profile views, not repeated three-quarter views. Make stable distinctive landmarks and physically coherent occlusions. Each view gets only its exact readable name below. No perspective diagram arrows, no environment, no ground tile, no props, no anatomy, no hands, no logos/watermarks. Small footer reads "360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND".

specs.title: MEAT
specs.body: One thick raw boneless red steak pickup, matching the red steak on the Havenline butcher table in the reference. Simple rounded asymmetrical teardrop cut, 1.3wide x0.9deep x0.3thick. Fresh saturated muted-red flesh, broad cream fat rim, two or three simple cream marbling lines, soft rounded sculpted edges. A small notch on FRONT-RIGHT perimeter; wider round lobe at LEFT and tapered narrower tip atRIGHT. No gore, blood, carcass, organs, plate, packaging, fork, board or snow. One steak only in everypanel, same fat/marbling pattern anchored to its top and visible coherent sides as it rotates. Camera angle high enough to see marbling but keep 0/90/180/270 true directions. FRONT45 and REARLEFT225 must have the SAME overall diagonal silhouette with opposite near surfaces; REARRIGHT135 and FRONTLEFT315 share the opposite diagonal silhouette.225 MUST NOT resemble135. At180 wider lobe is onimageRIGHT and tipLEFT, the reverse of0.

specs.title: FISH
specs.body: One whole stylized freshwater food fish pickup, matching the fish hanging on the Havenline drying rack and the resource-game reference. Short chunky smooth arctic trout: desaturated deep-blue back, pale cool-silver sides, cream belly, warm muted coral-orange fins, broad simple scale hints, tiny black eyes on BOTH sides. Length1.7 bodyheight0.7depth0.45, forked substantial tail, one dorsal fin, paired sidefins and undersidefins, no exaggerated smile, no cartoon face, no anthropomorphic character. Front is LEFT SIDE OF FISH with head pointing imageLEFT and tailRIGHT. AtREAR180 show opposite side with headimageRIGHT and tailLEFT. RIGHT90 looks straight fromtailtowardhead: forkedtailnearest, headoccludedbybody. LEFT270 looks straight atfishface: pairedvisibleeyes symmetrically, circularclosedmouth, bodytailbehind. At45 tailnearer right side, at135 tailnearer leftside, at225 headnearer LEFTside with opposite bodyface, at315 headnearerRIGHTside with original bodyface; do not repeat sideview with relabeled angles. Natural rigidbody laying horizontally as asset on hiddenground with softshadow, no plate/crate/ice/snow/water/hook. Exact same fins/shape/colors everyview.

specs.title: WHEAT
specs.body: One short tied wheat-sheaf pickup bundle, 14 sturdy golden stems and SIX prominent plump wheat ears, trimmed flat at bottom. The bundle lies horizontally alongX axis to be stackable: cut stem ends on objectLEFT, golden wheatheads extending towardRIGHT. One simple warm-brown cloth tie around stems at center; no decorative ribbon, no basket, sack, farmland, snow or base. Broad sculpted golden grains readable like Havenline stylized wooddetail; avoid wispy microdetail and hairlike bristles. Give the center tie a small seam only onFRONT face, hiddeninREAR. At0 fullhorizontalbundlewith cutstemsLEFT and seedheadsRIGHT;180 reverse headsLEFT/stemsRIGHT. AtRIGHT90 look into clustered seedheads, stemcutends behind; LEFT270 look at circular array trimmedstemends with seedheadsbehind. RearLEFT225 must show the cutstemend towardimageRIGHT, broadrearface toimageLEFT, unlike135 which shows seedheads onimageLEFT. Same 6wheatear arrangement across allviews, no new/missingflowers.
